claim: Antigravity plugin directory layout puts plugin.json, mcp_config.json, hooks.json at plugin root and skills/<name>/SKILL.md, agents/<name>.md, rules/AGENTS.md underneath; agy plugin install supports official marketplace, GitHub repo URL, or local directory and outputs components via agy plugin list --json; agy plugin validate --strict --json validates all components.

Hooks load from workspace .agents/hooks.json, global ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (never ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json), or plugin hooks.json. Supported events: SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, Stop. PreInvocation can inject systemMessage (including metadata.user_markdown) or terminate; SessionStart injects startup context.

MCP configs live in global ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json, workspace .agents/mcp_config.json, or plugin mcp_config.json. Antigravity spawns stdio processes via Language Server, caches tool schemas under <app-data-dir>/mcp/<serverName>/ (lazy vs eager), and uses mcp(server/*) allow/deny permissions. Changing user mcp_config.json or PATH requires MCP server Restart (/mcp reload or IDE restart) and fresh server names if overriding running global servers.

Plugin path variables: PLUGIN_ROOT (read-only ~/.gemini/config/plugins/<name>) and PLUGIN_DATA (persistent writable data directory outside plugin/workspace that survives updates/reinstalls) are automatically exported as env vars to BOTH plugin MCP servers and installed plugin command hooks. However, hooks.json 'command' strings do NOT substitute ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/${PLUGIN_DATA} literals (use relative scripts + process.env.PLUGIN_DATA); mcp_config.json expands ${PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${PLUGIN_DATA}, and mcpServers.<srv>.variables.

Global Antigravity rules live at ~/.gemini/AGENTS.md, ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md, ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md, ~/.gemini/config/GEMINI.md, or ~/.gemini/config/rules/*.md (not ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), subject to 24,000-byte per-file and 20,000-token aggregate budget. CLI settings and tool permissions live at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json (written atomically at mode 0600); ~/.gemini/config/config.json manages plugin enablement and App settings and must not be hand-clobbered.

Antigravity Terminal Sandbox (Linux namespaces, macOS sandbox-exec, Windows AppContainer on Win11 24H2+) blocks non-workspace writes and disables outbound network by default unless outside-sandbox or allowlisted. Zero-to-full installers must explicitly request unsandboxed execution or batch OS package installs so user only approves once.

Antigravity official cold-start installers: CLI uses 'curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash' (macOS/Linux -> ~/.local/bin/agy) and 'irm https://antigravity.google/cli/install.ps1 | iex' (Windows -> %LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin); Antigravity IDE/App uses antigravity.google/download bundles.

Cross-OS non-root user-space runtime bootstrap: 'uv' standalone installer (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh or winget astral-sh.uv) + 'uv python install --default' installs Python 3 + python/python3 into ~/.local/bin without sudo or WindowsApps Store stubs; Windows winget installs Git.Git, OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS, astral-sh.uv silently via '--exact --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements'; Linux/macOS non-sudo Node uses fnm (curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash) or brew.
